acceptanceCriteria: Dogfood begin/finish receipts and the witness report carry the packet coverage block (packet_bytes, budget_bytes, within_budget, included and omitted result counts) for each compiled packet, with the field names unchanged from the packet.
The fields are documented in the receipt profile with requirement IDs; existing receipt fixtures are updated and the reader tolerates their absence in older receipts.
One dogfood run on this repository shows the numbers in the recorded receipt in docs/BUILD-LOG.md.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air tracks credits per session and automation. Corvint already computes `packet_bytes`, `budget_bytes`, `within_budget` and coverage counts for every packet (visible in the hook output) but the dogfood and witness receipts do not carry them, so a cost view cannot attribute context spend to a change. This is a small projection change, not a new metric.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #130 (merge 92e9ac4ea). Criterion 1: the corvint-dogfood-change/0 report (read by dogfood finish) and the witness report carry packetCoverage with packet_bytes, budget_bytes, within_budget, included_results and omitted_results under the packet's names (script/dogfood-change.sh:274, internal/witness/witness.go:183-199, :333-395). Interpretation: dogfood begin compiles no packet and records none, and the finish receipt itself is unchanged (DCW-V0-016, docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md:90-100). Criterion 2: documented as AGW-V0-003 (corvint-witness-v0.md:51) and DCW-V0-016; the dogfood-change_test.sh fixtures are updated, and TestConsoleDogfoodPacketCoverage reads a pre-member report as not reported. Criterion 3: a real dogfood-change run of 8729b92 against d138a58 in a throwaway clone recorded prechange-query 6314 bytes and prechange-impact 8831 bytes (docs/BUILD-LOG.md:289-330). Witness tests pass at 6d4873a. Owner-only: AGW-V0-003 and DCW-V0-016 are proposed, not accepted. Known limit: omitted_results does not show closure truncation at the ranking ceiling. Receipt repin follow-up V1-0216. Sealed at .corvint/changes/e54d5b2ede58253d45fe4401cd8746fecf9009a8.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, witness.go, dogfood-change.sh, daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md, BUILD-LOG.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: receipts: surface `packet_bytes`, `budget_bytes` and coverage counts in dogfood and witness receipts so context cost is attributable per change
